title: Integrating sensor fusion with machine learning for comprehensive assessment of phenotypic traits and drought response in poplar species.
summary: Sensor fusion and machine learning relate poplar phenotypic traits to drought response using measured plant and environmental observations.
ai_technology: The source evaluates machine-learning classifiers/regressors on sensor-derived traits under drought treatments with fivefold validation.
